spans.s:
The affix क comes after the verbs परिमृज् 'to wash out' and अपनुद् 'to drive away' when in composition with the words तुन्द 'navel' and शोक 'grief', as objects respectively.

Terms: क

The affix इलच् also comes in the sense of मतुप् after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) तुन्द etc.

Terms: इलच्

The affix भ comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. तुन्दि 2. वलि and 3. वटि।

Terms: भ
